objective: Lower margin error and win-probability log loss than the current CFB card engine (football/cfb_p4/engine.js projectGame, edgedesk_cfb_p4_v1.0.1) out of sample, measured against the closing line as the baseline, on FBS-vs-FBS and FBS-vs-FCS games separately and together.
unit: every game with at least one FBS side (regular season and postseason) with a final score and a closing spread (cfbfastR line archive median across books 2006-2025 via football/cfb_p4/research/build_market.py; 2026: record/football/cfb_2026.json, DraftKings via ESPN, frozen at kickoff)

slices.all: every game with an FBS side
slices.fcs: FBS vs FCS or a lower division

metrics: share of games 3+ points from the close
ATS vs close at 1/2/3 pt gaps
line movement toward the model (opener to close, archive openers 2014-2025)

tuning.objective: margin MAE on the tune window, every game with an FBS side and a close (FBS and FCS together)
tuning.method: coordinate descent, two passes, over the grid below, starting from the defaults in model_loop/adapters/cfb/ratings.py DEFAULTS and model.py MODEL_DEFAULTS as committed with this file; garbage-time weight fixed at 0.25 (not tuned) and tested only as an ablation

incremental_value_bar: On the VALIDATION window only (all games), each component is removed from the tuned model. A component stays active only if removing it raises validation margin MAE or validation log loss; otherwise it is marked inactive and the model is refitted without it. The holdout is not consulted.
decision_rule: v2 may replace cfb_p4 v1.0.1 on the card only if, on the 2025 holdout (all games), it has lower margin MAE AND lower log loss than the cfb_p4 replay on the same games, AND it is not worse on the full 2014-2025 backtest. Otherwise cfb_p4 stays and v2 remains EXPERIMENTAL. Beating the close is reported, not required.
baseline: football/cfb_p4/engine.js v1.0.1 (home field 2.8 via home_field.js) replayed cold from 2006, every game projected before it is absorbed (model_loop/adapters/cfb/baselines/replay_cfb_p4.js). Its trained coefficients were fitted on 2001-2025 in layers, so before 2026 the replay has an in-sample advantage. No team-game efficiency feed is supplied, so its matchup term is 0 (it reproduces the published 2022-2025 FBS MAE within 0.06). 2026 is also compared with what the record actually published.
inactive_by_data: coaching change / tenure (the feed's coaching series starts 2015 and carries no publication date; not built)
historical QB starter announcements (the backtest prices the QB who took the most dropbacks)
Pinnacle closes after 2019 (the benchmark is the median across books)
travel distance / time zones (venue geography not ingested in this round)
data_caveats: Talent (247 composite) and returning production come from sportsdataverse-data releases that carry no publication timestamp; for past seasons they are reconstructions from that season's roster, so their contribution is measured by ablation, not assumed point-in-time clean.
The 2013 play-by-play feed files almost no sacks (53 vs ~3,500 a season), so 2013 pass ratings are rosier; 2013 is a burn-in season for the tune window's priors only.
Garbage time uses the provider's NAIVE win probability (game state only); its wp_before reads the pregame spread and is not used.

forking_paths.disclosed_before_tuning: During development one smoke test of a first, untuned configuration (market prior 3 games of evidence, half-life 4, carry 0.6; unit priors 300/600 plays) was scored on every window including the 2025 holdout (all games: v2 MAE 13.12 vs close 11.90; FBS 12.99 vs 11.82). A diagnostic of that market rating's compression (close regressed on the market rating, by week) was run on 2014-2024, which includes the validation window: the market rating was shrunk ~1.5x. Four market settings and then the full model with the defaults committed here were scored on the TUNE window only (2014-2020: all games MAE 13.21 vs close 12.47; FBS 13.02 vs 12.45), and the defaults and the market grid were set from those. No setting was changed in response to the holdout. The cfb_p4 replay was scored on 2014-2025 to check it reproduces the published numbers.
forking_paths.structural_choices: no intercept (neutral = 0); offense and defense separate coefficients; QB as its own rating parameter carried with the player through transfers; every FCS / lower-division team in the play-by-play rated, around a fitted division mean; per-slate snapshots (a midweek game is not absorbed before that week's Saturday games); the postseason in weekly slates.
